sk: Určite nebolo najlepším riešením poflakovať sa po nočných uliciach, ale keď mám byť úprimná, stále to bolo lepšie ako krčiť sa v našom stiesnenom byte; takmer vždy som počula viac zvuky sexu od susedov ako hudbu, čo som si púšťala. S rýchlym nádychom som sa zahľadela späť na cestu pred sebou – zrejme to zvrtnem k Alovej záložni, kde sa dá dobre zabiť čas prezeraním rôznych zbytočností. Keď sa však za mnou ozvali niečie kroky, pôvodný plán som ihneď oľutovala. Možno som tomu venovala príliš veľkú pozornosť, lenže týmito miestami nikto nechodil, ak sa nechcel nechať okradnúť alebo zmlátiť. Bola to obľúbená štvrť mafiánov a členov rôznych gangov, ktorí tu viedli svoj biznis...
en: Wandering the dark streets late at night wasn’t usually the best option, but honestly, it was better than staying in that stuffy apartment; hell most of the time you could hear the neighbors having sex more than you could hear your music. With a quick, breathy sigh, I returned my gaze to the walk ahead–I’ll probably make my way towards Al’s Pawnshop; just a place I find junk that looks interesting, as a pastime. Quick regret flushed over me as I heard footsteps close behind, maybe I'm overthinking it, but nobody hung around this place unless they wanted to get mugged, or beaten up. It was popular for its mafia and gang activities…

sk: Smiešne, nie? Neostala nám ani polovica sily, no aj tak sme sa nevedeli ovládnuť natoľko, aby sme jeden druhému neubližovali. Náhlivo som zrýchlila. Alov podnik je za rohom, vnútri budem v bezpečí. Keď som dorazila pred jasne žiariaci pútač s nápisom „Albornova záložňa!“, pohľadom ponad plece som sa ubezpečila, že ma nikto nesleduje. Pomalým krokom som vošla už do druhého podniku – toto miesto bolo tak trochu v podzemí, pretože Alborn sem často vodil mutantov, ktorým sa podarilo prešmyknúť do Paltricusu. Otvorila som dvere, lenže dnu sa nesvietilo. Zaujímavé. Po Alovi takisto ani stopa. Žiadni utečenci. Nič. Niečo tu nehralo.
en: Isn’t that funny? We have half the manpower left, and we can’t even refrain from hurting one another. I hastily sped up, Al’s was around the corner, so I would be fine inside. A glance behind me ensured that I was no longer being tailed as I stood in front of a bright glowing sign that read, “Alborn’s Pawnshop!” With slower steps, I entered once again–this place was more under the cover, as Alborn would often take in people who’d been mutated and snuck into Paltricus. Upon opening the door, the lights had been shut off, interestingly enough–there was no Al. No refugees. Nothing. Something wasn’t right here.

sk: Prikradla som sa do zadnej časti obchodu. Spoza kovovej debny, ktorou by nepohol ani poltucet chlapov, som počula mumlanie a tlmenú vravu. Najtichším a najbezpečnejším riešením sa mi momentálne zdalo vyšplhať sa do vetracieho potrubia; keby sa mi podarilo preplaziť sa ponad debnu, počula by som, o čom sa zvláštne oblečení muži rozprávajú. Vnútri som zbadala spútaného Ala. Zrejme ho nakoniec dostali.
en: Stealthily I made my way towards the back of the store, murmurs and talking heard beyond a metal grate which took a few yanks to tear off. Climbing into the vent was the safest and quietest option for me right now; climbing my way through, I’d pick up on conversations and talks between strangely dressed men. I noticed Al inside, chained. Figures he’d get caught eventually.

sk: Alborn bol skvelý chlap, ale toto vyzeralo vážne. Nemala som však potrebu strkať do toho nos, najmä keď táto čeliadka pôsobila, ako keby sa práve stihla pohádať so všetkými mestskými pohlavármi. Hm, stále som sa toho pocitu nemohla zbaviť. S tichým zastonaním som sa zošuchla popri debne podo mnou a dopadla som do zatuchnutej miestnosti. „Psst. Al. Al!“ Al najprv neodpovedal, tak som prešla zo šepkania do hlasnejšieho levelu. „Lilith? Čo tu robíš...? Musíš zmiznúť, inak ťa chytí.“
en: Alborn was a great guy, but this looked serious. No need to stick my nose out for someone, especially when they seem like they’ve just gotten into trouble with every authority in the city. Yet, I still couldn’t shake the feeling. Letting a silent sigh escape me, I slowly warped off the grate below, dropping down into the quiet room. “Psst. Al. Al!” I whispered, giving a soft yell at his lack of response. “Lilith? What are you doing here..? You’ve gotta leave, he’ll catch you.”

sk: Nehrozí, zamrmlala som si pre seba. Pokúsila som sa odomknúť reťaze omotané okolo jeho ramien, keď sa k nám priblížil zvuk hlasov a tiché kroky sa začali ozývať hlasnejšie. „Rýchlo! Vráť sa do vetracej šachty, zmizni a už sem nechoď. Ak sa ešte niekedy stretneme, nebude to v tomto meste.“ Hovoril rýchlo a výraz paniky na jeho tvári ma vôbec neupokojoval. Dala som na jeho radu a viac som sa nezdržiavala. Do riti, Al. Vysúkala som sa z vetracieho potrubia a ušla som tak rýchlo, ako som len vládala; strata blízkeho priateľa zabolela. Idú ho odviezť do... iného mesta? Mojou mierne nesústredenou mysľou sa mihalo množstvo vecí, ktoré boli väčšinou smutné, no zároveň ma hnevali. Mestá za hranicou som mala naštudované zo všetkých možných zdrojov, aj Alcatraz pomenovaný podľa väznice - z toho, čo som prečítala, to bol viac než vhodný názov, nehovoriac o tom, že ľudia, ktorí sa vyhli mutácii, prerušili všetky zostávajúce styky s nakazenou krajinou, bola to... tragédia.
en: No shit, I silently voiced to myself. Attempting to lockpick the chains that wrapped around his arms, voices closed in on our location, the faint footsteps growing ever louder. “Quick! Get back in the vent, and leave. Do not come back. If we meet again, it won’t be in this city.” He said hurriedly, the flash of panic on his face didn’t help my nerves at all. Listening to his advice. I couldn’t bring myself to stay longer. Fuck, Al. I quickly ran for it after exiting the vent; it hurt a bit to lose such an invaluable friend. Were they moving him to the…other city? So many things were flicking through my slightly scattered mind, and most of them were angry but sad. I’d done numerous kinds of research on the outer cities, and the capital of the infected, Alcatraz, which they named after the prison – felt like it fit the name pretty well from what I’d read. Not to mention the unmutated had cut any remaining connecting land with infected land, it was…tragic.

sk: Cesta domov bola tichá, no vnútri som celá burácala. Myšlienok, ktoré sa snažili opantať môj rozum, pribúdalo, viackrát sa ma zmocnila ľútosť, že som neostala pri Alovi, aby som mu pomohla. Konečne doma. Hrozná prechádzka za ohlušujúcich zvukov ozývajúcich sa z oblakov nad nami ma takmer dohnala k slzám. Výbuchy hromu by za určitých okolností vystrašili iných hrdinov, ako som ja. Otec už odfukoval na gauči, v telke išla repríza nejakého filmu spred 10 - 12 rokov. Vzlykajúc som sa ticho odplazila späť do mojej izby. Hodila som sa na posteľ a oči sa mi začali pomaly zatvárať, až som upadla do hlbokého spánku.
en: The walk home was quiet, but so loud. The thoughts infecting my brain were booming, and the regret of not having stayed to help flashed over multiple times. I finally arrived home, almost brought to tears by the dreadful walk in the burst of sounds from the clouds above, the thunderous booms were enough to frighten any person sometimes. Dad was already passed out on the couch, some rerun of an older movie, probably 10-12 years old; sighing, I quietly crept my way back to my room. Flopping in the bed, I wasn’t able to keep my eyes open for long. Before long, slumber crept up on me.

sk: VÝBUCH
en: DETONATION
JANUARY 19th, 2:34 PM, 2543.

sk: Uvedomila som si to až po istom čase. Od Albornovho únosu prešlo niekoľko dní - nemala som potuchy, kam ho odviezli, vedela som len to, že zmizol z mesta. Oblečenie sa mi zdalo povedomé, ale na prvý pohľad som ho nevedela zaradiť. So zastonaním som položila ruky na systém predo mnou vyžarujúci červené a fialové svetlo - možno sa mi podarí heknúť zabezpečenie, miesto nie je príliš ďaleko a pochybujem, že by mali zavedené nejaké opatrenia... Možno by som nemala. Moje prsty sa začali bez ohľadu na akékoľvek morálne zásady podvedome pohybovať a vyťahovať rozličné obrazovky; ty vole, ja som aká dobrá. Na niektorých webstránkach som bola brutálne populárna. Volali ma „PRÍZRAK“, bola to taká slovná hračka. Na všetkých stránkach som vystupovala pod menom PR179AK, no myšlienka, že si to vymysleli sami ľudia, sa mi páčila.
en: The days rolled past before I could even realize it. It was a few days since Alborn was taken away – to where I had no clue, but I knew he was taken somewhere. Those outfits seemed familiar, but no way was I going to figure it out on the first try. Sighing, I placed my hands on the system in front of me, emanating a red and purple glow – I could hack the security, the place isn’t far, and I doubt they took measures...Maybe I shouldn’t. Of course, against all morals, my fingers moved without my knowing, pulling up multiple screens; god I’m good. I was pretty popular on a couple of websites, they referred to me as “WRAITH.” Which was a pretty catchy name. Granted my name on any site is WR417H, but I like to think the public came up with it.

sk: Preniesla som si kamerové sledovanie do mobilu, aby som mohla všetkých intenzívne sledovať. Nič. Vyzeralo to, ako keby tam nikto nebol. To nedáva zmysel. Kamery sú prísne zabezpečené, dokonca so vzdialeným prístupom. Ako...? VŔŔŔ. Nahnevane som vstala, pripravená vyhnať tie myšlienky z hlavy - prinútila som sa kráčať, vkĺzla som do topánok a vzala som si kľúče. „Oci, hneď som späť.“ Ticho. Nevadí, málokedy odpovedal, aj tak robil pravdepodobne niečo oveľa dôležitejšie ako ja.
en: Moving the surveillance onto my mobile device, I watched each one intently. Nothing. It was like they were never there. That makes no sense. Cameras had tight security, even with remote access. How..? ARGH. I stood angrily, ready to remove some thoughts from my head – I made my way over, sliding on shoes and taking my keys. “I’ll be back soon, Dad.”Silence. Whatever, he didn’t usually respond, he was probably busy doing something more important than me anyway.

sk: Keď som odchádzala z domu, zacítila som, ako sa mi po jednom rýchlom pohybe rozliala dolu chrbticou triaška; divné. Nevšímala som si to a prinútila som sa kráčať smerom k Alovmu obchodu, aby som to tam mohla trochu preskúmať, nohy ma však nasmerovali k Antonovmu malému bistru – bolo to veľmi pokojné miesto a zo všetkého najviac som sa teraz potrebovala s niekým porozprávať. A kto sa na túto úlohu hodil viac, než barman, ktorý mi je niečo dlžný?
en: With a quick jolt, I felt a shiver enthrall its way down my spine as I made my way out of the apartment; weird. Ignoring the feeling, I urged myself to head towards Al’s to investigate a little, but my legs moved towards Anton’s small bar – it was a pretty calm place, and I definitely needed to talk to someone. Who better than a bartender who owes you something?

sk: V Antonovom podniku bolo na počudovanie mimoriadne živo; prekypoval aktivitou a mihali sa v ňom nové tváre, ktoré som nikdy predtým nevidela - Anton bol zvyčajne jediným zamestnancom, takže musel kmitať ostošesť. „Hej, barman, jednu kávu.“ Schválne som hovorila hlbším hlasom, aby som ho trochu zmiatla, a nemohla som sa ubrániť smiechu, keď sa ku mne rýchlo otočil a viditeľne sa mu uľavilo. „Bože, Lilith, to mi nerob...“, povedal naoko káravo, viditeľne unavený. „Vyzeráš, že melieš z posledného... potrebuješ pomoc? Pozerám, že dnes máš pekne narvané.“ Ohrnula som nos, nechcelo sa mi riešiť týchto ožranov, ale mala by som zlý pocit, keby som ho nechala, aby si s tým poradil sám. „Mohla by si? Potom ti zaplatím...“ zahľadel sa mi priamo do očí s výrazom šteniatka. Pokročilá vojnová taktika...
en: Irregularly, Anton’s was pretty busy; it was bustling with activity and new faces that I’ve never seen before – Anton was regularly the only worker, so knowing that he must be pretty stressed. “Hey Barkeep, get me a coffee.” I purposely spoke in a lower tone to throw him off a bit, a small chuckle escaping me seeing his sigh of relief after turning quickly. “God, Lilith, don’t do that to me…” he softly let out, obviously tired. “You seem pretty busy…you need some help? Look’s like there's more than plenty of folks here.” I huffed out, I do not want to help with these drunks, but I feel bad making this guy work alone out here. “Could you? I’ll pay you after…” he uttered with the eyes of a puppy, aimed straight at me. Advanced War Tactics…

sk: Prezliekla som sa do tesnej uniformy a pomáhala som trochu za barom. Nebolo na tom nič ťažké okrem neustáleho flirtovania a vypiskovania ľudí z baru, no ak mám byť úprimná, až tak mi to nevadilo. Po šichte sa porozprávam s Antonom, stále potrebujem dostať Ala z hlavy, hoci viem, že potom sa do jeho obchodu aj tak budem musieť ísť pozrieť, ale zatiaľ...
en: After changing into the small uniform, I helped around the bar a bit, it was pretty easy aside from the constant flirting and cat-calling from the people within the bar; but it didn’t really bother me that much to be honest. I’ll talk to Anton after this shift, I still really need to get Al off my mind, though I know I’ll still investigate his place after this, but still…

sk: Obrovský Thraki zapálil veľmi špecifickú časť lesa a potom nad ňou istý čas krúžil a sledoval okolie. Z Thassalinových čeľustí vytryskla dávka plameňov. Čudné, keď Thraki spomalil, zvláštny zvuk kriku ozývajúci sa spoza neho ustal. Thassalin zabudol, že má na chrbte pasažierov.
en: A burst of flames erupted from Thassalin's jaws as the colossal Thraki set fire to a very specific patch of forest, then circled above, watching for moment. Weirdly, as he had slowed down, the weird screaming noise from behind him had stopped. Thassalin had forgotten he had passengers on his back.

sk: „No tak, Tenuk, na Thrakiho si sa predsa už vedel premeniť!“
en: "Come on, Tenuk, you've shapeshifted into a Thraki before!"

sk: „Áno, ale je úplne iné, keď letím sám a keď ma nasilu zdrapí obrovský ružový drak!“
en: "My own flight is very different from being abruptly dragged off by a massive, pink dragon!"

sk: „Nie je to také zlé, však, Kayel?“
en: "It's not that bad, right, Kayel?"

sk: Kayel s Nyssi očividne nesúhlasil, bol oveľa menej čierny ako zvyčajne a pazúry zaťal do Tassalinho chrbta tak hlboko, že Thraki by už dávno krvácal, Thassalin však tomu zjavne vôbec nevenoval pozornosť. Celý nešťastný si uvedomoval, že svojich nových priateľov vystrašil, a hľadal čistinku, na ktorej by mohol pristáť.
en: Kayel clearly didn't agree with Nyssi, he looked less black than normal and his claws had dug into Thassalin's back to the point that he'd made the Thraki bleed, but Thassalin clearly didn't seem to care. That being said, Thassalin had realized he had scared his new friends and found a clearing to land in.

sk: „OSPRAVEDLŇUJEM SA, ALE ZOBRAL SOM SI ARÓMU. MUSÍM TO ZVLÁDNUŤ!“
en: "I APOLOGIZE BUT I PICKED UP A SCENT. I HAD TO DEAL WITH IT!"

sk: „Musel si nás vziať so sebou?“, vybuchol Tenuk, keď sa snažil zliezť z Thassalinovho chrbta, spúšťajúc sa po jeho chvoste. „A vykašlali sme sa na Retvika! Opustili sme nášho veľkého, silného a bojovného kamoša! Ako sa k nám teraz dostane?“
en: "Did you have to drag us along as well?" Tenuk snapped as he climbed off Thassalin's back, sliding down his tail. "And we left Retvik behind! We abandoned our big, strong, fighty guy! How is he going to get to us?"

sk: „Niečo vymyslí...“, sykla Nyssi. „Retvik je síce pomalý, ale nie je hlúpy.“
en: "He'll work it out..." Nyssi tutted. "Retvik's slow but he's not stupid."

sk: „Hej, ale vie jazdiť?“
en: "Yeah but can Retvik drive?"

sk: Nyssi žmurkla a otočila sa späť k Tenukovi. „Samozrejme, že vie šoférovať.“
en: Nyssi blinked and turned back to Tenuk. "Of course he can drive."

sk: „Videl niekto niekedy Retvika za volantom? Nemá vlastný bourák ako vy a nikdy som ho nevidel šoférovať ani niečo také pekné malé, ako má Kayel. Do práce začal chodiť autom iba preto, lebo si trval na tom, že nás DO práce budeš voziť. Jemu však stačí ten jeho bike.“
en: "Have you ever seen Retvik drive a vehicle? He doesn't own a truck like you do, nor have I seen him drive something like that little cute car Kayel has, and he only started going to work by car because you keep on driving us TO work. He just has that bike of his."

sk: Prerušil ich výbuch smiechu. Thassalin bol zrazu celý vysmiaty, no nikto nevedel prísť na to, čo ho tak rozveselilo. Upokojil sa až po hodnej chvíli.
en: A burst of laughter interrupted them. Thassalin was suddenly overly amused, but no one could work out what he was laughing about. It took a little too long for Thassalin to calm down.

sk: „PREPÁČTE, ALE PREDSTAVIL SOM SI VÁŠHO VEĽKÉHO OPANCIEROVANÉHO KAMARÁTA NA MALOM BICYKLÍKU, NA KTOROM SA VOZIA TEMTHANOVE DETI. SKORO MA ROZTRHLO! ŠKODA, ŽE NEMÁM ASPOŇ KÚSOK TELEPATICKÝCH SCHOPNOSTÍ. TÁ PREDSTAVA BY SA MALA ZVEČNIŤ, NO NEVIEM SA O ŇU PODELIŤ!“
en: "I AM SORRY, BUT I PICTURED YOUR LARGE, ARMOURED FRIEND ON A TINY LITTLE BIKE MEANT FOR TEMTHAN CHILDREN. IT WAS HILARIOUS! I WISH I HAD SOME FORM OF TELEPATHY. IT IS A CHERISHED THOUGHT! ONE I CANNOT SHARE!"

sk: Keď si Kayel predstavil, čo behá Thassalinovi po rozume, rozchechtal sa. „OK, super. Čo si to však zobral, a prečo si tak rýchlo odletel?“
en: Kayel snickered, as he could imagine what Thassalin was thinking about. "Yeah, fair. But what did you pick up, and why did you fly off so quickly?"

sk: Thassalin zavrčal, vzlietol a na chvíľu sa vytratil. Po návrate položil pred Nyssi mŕtve telo. Bol to Orothrack, veľmi vzácna zlato-biela dračia bytosť. Telu chýbala hlava. „ĎALŠÍ MŔTVY KUS. POČUL SOM, AKO NARIEKAJÚ. CÍTIL SOM ICH KRV. LÁKA MA TO, ABY SOM CHRÁNIL A LOVIL. PODĽA POKYNOV YISINI. TIE NETVORY SÚ DOSŤ BLÍZKO.“
en: Thassalin grunted, took off and disappeared briefly, before returning, dropping a carcass in front of Nyssi. It was an Orothrack, a very rare, gold and white draconic creature. But its head was missing. "ANOTHER DEAD ONE. I HEAR THEIR CRIES. SMELL THEIR BLOOD. I AM DRAWN TO PROTECT AND HUNT. AS YISINI DEMANDS. THE CREATURES, THEY ARE CLOSE."

sk: Mocný Thraki odrazu stuhol, rovnako ako Nyssi a Kayel, ktorých pozornosť upútal otvor na čistine. Hľadelo na nich niečo veľké, čierne a syčiace. Nech už to bolo čokoľvek, roztvorilo to dva páry obrovských krídel a začalo to postupovať smerom k Thassalinovi bez ohľadu na to, že v ceste stáli ďalšie tri drobné stvorenia. Kayelovi a Tenukovi sa podarilo uhnúť len tak-tak, Nyssi však obor zachytil a takmer šmaril na Thassalina.
en: The mighty Thraki suddenly froze. Nyssi and Kayel also froze, their attention drawn to a gap in the clearing. Something large and black was staring at them, hissing. Whatever it was, it spread open two colossal pairs of wings and charged forward, aiming at Thassalin, not caring that it had to go through the three smaller beings. Kayel and Tenuk only just managed to get to cover, but Nyssi found herself dragged along and almost thrown at Thassalin.

sk: Thassalin na útok zareagoval tak, že schmatol Nyssi a neuveriteľne dlhým obratným chvostom si ju šupol na chrbát. Potom vzlietol. Štvorkrídle čierne stvorenie sa rýchlo pustilo za nimi.
en: Thassalin responded to this attack by grabbing Nyssi and throwing her on his back with his insanely long, dextrous tail, before taking off into the air. The black, two-winged creature quickly chased after them.

sk: Kayel so syknutím strhol z chrbta pušku, otvoril vrecko a uvoľnil pás s nábojmi, ktorý si prevesil krížom cez prsia, aby k nim mal lepší prístup. Rýchlo si však uvedomil, že Nyssi, Thrakiho aj monštrum medzitým stratil z dohľadu.
en: Kayel tutted as he drew his rifle from his back, then opened up a pouch, revealing a bandolier. He slung the bandolier over his chest for easy access, but quickly realized that Nyssi, the Thraki and the monster were no longer visible.

sk: „Tenuk, vedel by si sa premeniť na niečo, čo dokáže lietať?“, spýtal sa Kayel.
en: "Hey, Tenuk, do you mind shapeshifting into something that can fly?" Kayel asked.

sk: „Chceš ich prenasledovať?“
en: "You want to chase after them?"

sk: „Tomu ver.“
en: "Yeah, duh."

sk: „Lenže... jeden z nich je tá obluda!“
en: "But... one of them is a giant monster!"

sk: „No a? Mám brutálnu zbraň a som pripravený vyraziť. Jediné, čo potrebujem, je dostať sa k nej na dohľad, aby som ju mohol zostreliť.“
en: "So? I have a high-powered rifle in my hands, right now, ready to go. I just need to be able to, you know, see it, so I can shoot it."

sk: Tenuk zaváhal, potom urobil krok vzad, aby mal viac miesta. S hlbokým, mierne bolestným zavrčaním sa jeho telo natiahlo, srsť sa zmenila na šupiny a namiesto rúk mu narástli krídla. Rýchlo sa premenil na normálneho bledomodrého Thrakiho, iba jeho oči ostali červené.
en: Tenuk hesitated, then stepped back, giving himself some space. With a low, slightly pained grunt, Tenuk's body stretched out, his fur replaced with scales and his arms replaced with wings. He quickly turned himself into a normal, light blue Thraki, but his eyes remained red.

sk: „Nastúp.“
en: "Climb on."

sk: Tenuk s výzorom normálneho Thrakiho mal teraz na chrbte pásy so šupinami, bez problémov však vyčaroval aj pár ostňov, aby sa mal Kayel čoho zachytiť. Hodnú chvíľu trvalo, kým sa Tenuk vzniesol do vzduchu, potom sa však rýchlo zorientoval a z celej sily sa pustil do naháňačky.
en: Being a more normal-looking Thraki, Tenuk now had proper plates of scales running down his back, but he'd also conveniently grown a pair of spikes on his back for Kayel to hold on to. It took a little too long for Tenuk to get airborne, but once he was in the air, he quickly orientated himself and tried to give chase.

sk: No obidvaja si rýchlo uvedomili, že nie sú sami. Zospodu k nim vyrazilo druhé tmavé monštrum a Tenuk sa len tak-tak vyhol zrážke.
en: However, Tenuk and Kayel quickly realized they weren't alone. A second dark creature shot out from beneath them, and Tenuk only just managed to avoid a collision.

sk: „To bude asi ten druhý hrozný netvor, pred ktorým nás varoval Lanex“, zamračil sa Kayel pokúšajúc sa druhú beštiu zostreliť. Minul ju a rýchlo znovu nabil.
en: "I guess that's the other big scary monster that Lanex was worried about?" Kayel frowned as he attempted to take a shot at the second beast, missed and swiftly reloaded.

sk: Tenuk neodpovedal, príliš ho zamestnával let smerom k Nyssi a Thassalinovi napriek tomu, že druhý netvor im bol v pätách. Kayel sa nemotorne otočil, aby mal netvora na očiach. To, že ich netvor prenasledoval, vyhodnotil Kayel ako výhodu, pretože mohol ľahšie namieriť a vystreliť. Dve strely mu prešli cez vrchnú časť krídel. Netvor zaručal bolesťou a zmizol pod korunami stromov. Kayel si nebol istý, či ich ešte prenasleduje, v každom prípade však bude oveľa pomalší.
en: Tenuk didn't respond, he was too busy concentrating on flying towards Nyssi and Thassalin, even though the other creature was chasing them. Kayel awkwardly turned himself around, so he could face the monster. The fact that it was giving chase was good news in Kayel's eyes, as it made it easier for him to aim and fire. Two shots passed through the creature's top wings, and it roared in pain, disappearing back below the trees. Whether it was still following them, Kayel wasn't sure, but it certainly wouldn't have been able to keep up.

sk: Nyssi sa zatiaľ držala zubami-nechtami Thassalina, ktorý sa oháňal okolo seba a častoval čiernu potvoru spŕškami plameňov. Príšera bola očividne zranená, čo ju však iba rozzúrilo a vôbec nevyzerala, že by sa chcela vzdať. Ani ohnivé gule nenarobili toľko škody, ako by sa mohlo zdať. Keď sa však Thassalin vzpriamil, Nyssi využila príležitosť a vytiahla svoju starú vernú brokovnicu. Určite nebola určená na tento druh boja, ale náhodný výstrel by mohol čiernu obludu aspoň vystrašiť, či?
en: Up ahead, Nyssi was clinging on for dear life as Thassalin flailed around, blasting the blackened monster with bursts of flame. While the creature was definitely injured, it seemed very pissed off and unwilling to back off, and the fire balls didn't seem to be doing as much as they should. As Thassalin straightened himself out though, Nyssi took this as an opportunity to pull out her own weapon, a trusty shotgun. Sure, it wasn't meant for this sort of thing, but surely the scattershot would at least deter the black beast?

sk: Tak asi nie. Obluda iba zasyčala a pokúsila sa naletieť priamo do Thassalina. Thassalin bol však chvalabohu napriek svojim rozmerom dosť obratný na to, aby sa jej vyhol z cesty, iba čo Nyssi bezmocne skríkla, pretože sa takmer zošmykla z jeho príliš hladkých šupín.
en: No, clearly not. The creature just hissed and tried to fly directly into Thassalin. Thankfully, despite his size, Thassalin was nimble enough to get out of the way, but Nyssi couldn't help but scream as she very nearly lost her grip on Thassalin's overly smooth scales.

sk: „AKO ICH ZABIJEME?“ Skríkla.
en: "HOW DO WE KILL THEM?" Nyssi shouted.

sk: „MIER IM NA HLAVU!“
en: "AIM FOR THEIR HEADS!"

sk: „TO NEBUDE TAKÉ JEDNODUCHÉ!“
en: "THAT'S GONNA BE TRICKY!"

sk: Thassalin zasyčal a celý sa stočil bližšie k hore, ktorú nazýval svojím domovom. Tmavý netvor ich nasledoval, keď ho však zasiahol oheň spoza chrbta, ostal v rozpakoch, nevšimol si totiž, že tu už dávno nie sú sami. Jeho rozpaky sa ešte zväčšili, keď Thassalin spomalil a šľahol beštiu chvostom zboku do hlavy.
en: Thassalin hissed, then circled round, closer to the mountain he called home. The dark beast followed, but somewhat panicked as a blast of fire hit it from behind. The creature hadn't realised it was no longer alone. It panicked further as Thassalin slowed down then thwacked his tail into the side of the beast's head, knocking it off course.

sk: Netvor sa s prskaním a syčaním vzniesol vyššie a vypľúval do vzduchu sliny. Všetko zrazu potemnelo, akoby samotná príšera vysala z oblohy svetlo a nechala tam namiesto neho mrak večnej tmy.
en: Snarling and hissing, the creature flew upwards, spitting into the air. Everything suddenly went dark, as if the monster was sucking the light from the sky itself, replacing it with a cloud of perpetual night.

sk: Oslepený Thassalin sa pokúsil o ústup, vletel však do korún stromov a následne sa zrútil na čistinu. Netvor zrejme presne vedel, kde Thassalin dopadol, pretože sa rútil priamo k nemu, vlečúc temný mrak so sebou.
en: No longer able to see, Thassalin tried to retreat, but found himself scraping against the top of the treeline, before crashing into a clearing. The creature seemed to know exactly where Thassalin had fallen and headed straight for him, taking the dark cloud with it.

sk: „Kayel!“, zvolal Tenuk, ktorý vyplachtil z oblaku a začal krúžiť vôkol, snažiac sa rozpoznať Nyssi a Thassalina v temnote pod sebou. „Čo urobíme? Kayel...? Kayel, kde si?“
en: "Kayel!" Tenuk exclaimed as he glided out of the cloud and began circling, trying to spot Nyssi and Thassalin in the darkness below. "What do we do? Kayel..? Kayel, where are you?"

sk: Dolu na čistine sa Nyssi pozviechala zo zeme. Bola si stopercentne istá, že má niečo zlomené, medzitým však už stihli zasiahnuť jej zvláštne nadprirodzené liečivé schopnosti. To sa však nedalo povedať o Thassalinovi ležiacom na vyvýšenine a opierajúcom sa o jediný strom, ktorý sa nezlomil pod jeho váhou. Nyssi sa zo všetkých síl snažila dostať sa k nemu, videla však len na pár metrov pred seba. Všetko sa halilo do temnoty a svet okolo nej pohlcovali pekelné tiene, z ktorých sa ozýval vreskot a jačanie.
en: Below, Nyssi scrambled to her feet. She was pretty sure she had broken something, but her weird, unnatural healing powers had already kicked in. The same couldn't have been said for Thassalin, who was lying in a lump, resting against the one tree that hadn't collapsed under his weight. Nyssi did her best to try and reach Thassalin but she could barely see more than a couple of meters in front of her. Everything was pitch black and engulfed in unholy shadows. And in said shadows, something was screaming and screeching.

sk: Na zem vedľa Nyssi dopadol strašný chvostisko v tvare kyjaka, až ju odhodilo. Všimla si však, že nemieril na ňu, že iba bezcieľne mláti okolo. Netvor, ktorého stihla zazrieť a ktorého zvuky počula, vrčal a chniapal v temnote, ktorú sám vytvoril. V tme sa niečo teleportovalo a začalo to príšeru bodať, čo ju riadne vyviedlo z miery.
en: A horrible, clubbed tail smashed into the ground near Nyssi, knocking her over. She noticed though that the tail was flailing, not aiming at her. The creature, what little Nyssi could see and hear of it, was snarling and clawing at the shadows it had created. Something was teleporting through the darkness, stabbing at the monster, confusing it.

sk: Vzduch náhle preťal zvuk brokovnice, monštrum stíchlo, zviezlo sa na zem a ostalo nehybne ležať. Okolitá temnota sa rozplynula a odhalila, čo sa vlastne stalo. Na príšere stál ťažko dýchajúci Kayel so svojou zbraňou.
en: A gunshot suddenly filled the air, and the monster fell silent, collapsing on the ground and remaining still. The darkness all around them dissipated, revealing what had happened. Standing on top of the creature was Kayel, holding his rifle and breathing heavily.

sk: „To bol... jeden z najbizarnejších tieňových skokov, aký som kedy dal... Sim sala bim...“, Kayel zalapal po dychu. Oči mu zvláštne sčerneli a telom mu začala prúdiť temná energia. Kým však rozprával, vrátila sa mu organická oceľová farba a oči mal opäť normálne žlté.
en: "That was... one of the weirder shadowjumps I've ever done... Thanto kat'olon..." Kayel gasped for air. His eyes somehow were glowing black, and a dark energy drifted across his body. However, as he spoke, the colour returned to Kayel's organic plating and his eyes turned back to their normal yellow.

sk: Nyssi chvíľu trvalo, kým spracovala, čo sa stalo. Všetci vedeli, že Kayel má zvláštne tieňové schopnosti, ktoré veľmi často nevyužíval, pretože ich pokladal za démonické a príliš hrôzostrašné. Nyssi však nevedela, že ich dokáže použiť v temnote akéhokoľvek druhu. A podľa toho, ako sa Kayel správal, tiež ho to dosť prekvapilo.
en: It took a moment for Nyssi to work out what had happened. They were all aware that Kayel had weird shadow powers, ones that he rarely used because most considered them unholy and rather terrifying. But Nyssi didn't know that Kayel could use those powers in any sort of darkness. And, by the way Kayel was acting, he was pretty surprised as well.

sk: „Si v poriadku?“, vyšlo z Nyssi mimovoľne.
en: "You alright?" Nyssi couldn't help but ask.

sk: „Hej, nič mi nie je. Práve som niečo zabil, ale o minútku budem v pohode.„ Vedľa Kayela, ktorý sa kochal svojím dielom, pristál Tenuk a zmenil sa späť na normálnu bytosť.
en: "Yeah, I'm fine. I killed something, I'll be good in a minute." Kayel examined his handiwork, as Tenuk made his way down and landed next to him, shapeshifting back into his normal Spast form.

sk: Konečne si mohli nehybnú príšeru pozrieť zblízka. Jej pokožka bola čierna a slizká, pričom sliz vytváral na jej tele pevný pancier. Mala štyri krídla a štyri končatiny zakončené tenkými dlhými pazúrmi a z lebky jej vyrastali dva rovné rohy.
en: Now that the creature was no longer moving, they could better see what it was. Its skin was pitch black and slimy, but the slime remained firmly attached to the creature's body. It had four wings and four limbs, all of which were tipped with long, thin talons, and two straight horns stuck out from its skull.

sk: Tenuk a Kayel sa ešte ani nestihli opýtať, na čo sa to do riti vlastne pozerajú, keď v neďalekom kríku čosi vykríklo a vyrútilo sa to na nich. Kým to však stihlo niekoho ohroziť, do boku mu vrazilo známe vozidlo. Útočník sa zrútil priamo k Nyssiným nohám. Nyssi bez zaváhania schmatla pušku a v sekunde ho strelila priamo do hlavy. Bol na mieste mŕtvy.
en: Before Tenuk and Kayel could ask what the fuck they were looking at, something screeched and leaped out from a nearby bush. However, it never made contact, as a familiar vehicle crashed into the side of it, causing the monster to skid to a halt by Nyssi's feet. Not taking any chances, Nyssi grabbed her shotgun and immediately fired into its skull, killing the creature instantly.

sk: „Ups...“, zamrmlal Retvik spoza volantu, potom nemotorne vypol motor a vyliezol z auta. „Ehm, to som nechcel. Ste všetci v poriadku?“
en: "Oops..." Retvik muttered from the driver's seat, before awkwardly switching the engine off and climbing out of the truck. "I, uh, did not mean to do that. Are you all well?"

sk: „Zmeškal si prakticky celú bitku!“, sykol Tenuk. „Kde si bol?“
en: "You missed basically all the action!" Tenuk tutted. "Where were you?"

sk: „Tak nejako ste na mňa pozabudli. Prišiel som sem najrýchlejšie, ako sa dalo...“, hlesol Retvik. „Môžem sa spýtať, čo to tu máte za hrozné veci?“
en: "You all did somewhat leave me behind. I got here as quickly as I could..." Retvik sighed. "May I ask, what are those horrible things?"

sk: Na jeho otázku našťastie odpovedal Thasallin, ktorému sa konečne podarilo pozviechať. Bol síce samá odrenina a škrabanec a vyzeral trochu otrasene, vážne zranenia však zrejme nemal.
en: Retvik's question was thankfully answered by Thassalin, who had picked himself back up. He was covered in cuts and scratches and seemed a bit dazed, but he didn't seem too badly injured.

sk: „VY STE ZABILI KORUPTOIDOV! NAKAZENÉ OBLUDY. PRÍŠERY, KTORÉ TU OSTALI, KEĎ SA VAŠI BOHOVIA NECHALI OPANTAŤ KORUPCIOU.“
en: "YOU KILLED THE CORRUPTIIDS! THE INFECTED MONSTERS. CREATURES LEFT HERE WHEN THE CORRUPTION ATTACKED YOUR GODS."

sk: „Máš na mysli... tú hroznú bohovsky obludnú vec, ktorú sme... pomohli zabiť?“, vyjachtal Tenuk.
en: "You mean... the horrible god monster thing that we... helped kill?" Tenuk stuttered.

sk: „ÁNO. PRESNE TAK. A ZREJME ICH TU BUDE VIAC. JA ICH VŠAK NEVIEM STRELIŤ DO HLAVY. NEMÁM PUŠKU. A OKREM TOHO NIE JE FÉR, KEĎ ÚTOČIA DVAJA NA JEDNÉHO, JE TAK?“ Thassalin sa otočil ku Kayelovi a poklepkal ho po hlave. „DÍKY, KAMOŠKO. PRIPOMÍNAŠ MI STARÉHO ZNÁMEHO ARKADINA. AKURÁT MÁŠ NA KONTE MENEJ MŔTVOL A NECHCEŠ VYSTRIEĽAŤ CELÝ SVET.“
en: "YES. VERY MUCH SO. THERE MAY BE MORE. BUT I COULD NOT SHOOT THEM IN THE HEAD. I LACK A GUN. ALSO TWO AGAINST ONE IS UNFAIR, YES?" Thassalin made his way over to Kayel and patted him on the head. "THANK YOU, LITTLE ONE. YOU REMIND ME OF MY OLD FRIEND ARKADIN. EXCEPT LESS MURDEROUS AND LESS CAPABLE OF KILLING UNIVERSES."

sk: „Ehm... vďaka... teda...“, pokrčil plecami Kayel. „Takže, ehm, tu sme skončili?“
en: "Uh... thanks... I guess..." Kayel shrugged. "So, uh, are we done here?"

sk: Nyssi takisto pokrčila plecami a zobrala foťák, aby urobila pár záberov definitívne mŕtvych potvor. Potom vytiahla svoju obľúbenú, drahocennú a hovadsky vražednú dýku a pustila sa po jednom odrezávať potvore rohy. No hneď ako bola hotová, príšery zrazu vzbĺkli plameňom a o chvíľu z nich ostala iba kôpka popola. To isté sa stalo aj s rohmi, ktoré Nissy odrezala.
en: Nyssi shrugged, then grabbed her camera, taking some photos of the definitely now dead beasts. She then pulled out her favourite dagger, her fancy, death-god-y one, and started cutting off one of the creature's horns, before moving on to the other one. However, just as Nyssi finished, the creatures suddenly began to burn up, and quickly turned into a pile of ashes. The same thing happened to the horns Nyssi had cut off.

sk: „OK... prišlo to súčasne vhod aj nevhod...“, vzdychla si. „Dúfam, že mám aspoň fotky.“
en: "Well... that is both convenient and inconvenient..." Nyssi sighed. "I suppose at least I got pictures?"

sk: Predslov
en: Prologue

sk: „Prosím!“, úpenlivo žiadala kráľovná Eirween, „neposielajte ju preč! Veď je to ešte dieťa!“ Ľadový kráľ sa na manželku pozrel zo svojho trónu. Kráľovský radca postával vedľa neho. Porodila dievčatko. Pri tej myšlienke sa zamračil.
en: “Please!” Queen Eirwen begged, “don’t send her away! She’s just a child!” The Ice King looked down at his wife from his throne, his royal advisor next to him. She had given birth to a girl. He scowled at the thought.

sk: Dievča, o ktorom sa hovorilo, vyzeralo navlas ako jej matka. Bledomodré oči a biele vlasy ozdobené modrými šnúrkami. Ľadový kráľ bol presvedčený, že s dcérou bude vyzerať ako slaboch. Veď doteraz mal samých synov.
en: The girl in question looked a lot like her mother; pale blue eyes and white hair decorated with blue strands. The Ice King thought a daughter made him look weak. After all, he had only had sons up until this point.

sk: „Sú iba dve možnosti. Buď dieťa zabijeme alebo ho pošleme do divočiny. To je jej trest za tvoje previnenie, Eirwen.“ Vypľul manželkino meno, akoby to bol jed. Vlastne to tak robil odjakživa.
en: “The only options you have are to kill the child or send it out to the wilderness. This is her punishment for your wrongdoing, Eirwen .” He spat out her name as if it was poison. He always did.

sk: Frostfell nebýval vždy jedným kráľovstvom. Kedysi existoval Severný a Južný Frostfell. V severnom kráľovstve nemali žiadnu mágiu, zatiaľ čo južné bolo plné fantastických výjavov rozličných schopností. Chamtivosť severanov dohnala obe kráľovstvá k nekonečnej vojne, ktorá sa skončila v deň, keď južné kráľovstvo ponúklo prímerie.
en: Frostfell was not always one kingdom. It was split in two, the North and the South. In the North, the non magical kingdom. To the South, a kingdom full of fantastical displays of power. Due to the North’s greed, the two kingdoms clashed in a never ending war, until the South offered a truce.

sk: Južné kráľovstvo bolo zúfalé a kráľovská rodina by urobila čokoľvek, len aby zastavila krviprelievanie. Nakoniec prišli s ponukou, aby sa ich jediná dcéra stala kráľovnou Severu a aby porodila syna, ktorý sa stane budúcim kráľom. Severania ponuku prijali a princezná Eirwen si vzala za manžela princa Akulla.
en: The South was desperate, and their royal family would do anything to stop the bloodshed. They offered their only princess to be queen of the North and bear a son to be the future king. Then, the South would join with the North to make one kingdom. The North accepted, and Princess Eirwen married Prince Akull.

sk: „Na kolenách ťa prosím, môj pane, rob si so mnou, čo chceš, zamkni ma na sedem zámkov, vyžeň ma z domu alebo ma bárs aj zabi, len ušetri moje dieťa“, úpenlivo žiadala Eirwen, držiac dcéru pevne v náručí.
en: “I beg you, my king, in return for the safety of my child, do whatever you want to me, lock me up, banish me, or even kill me.” Queen Eirwen pleaded, holding her child tightly in her arms.

sk: Ľadový kráľ sa na kráľovnú pozrel so znechutením v očiach. Možno, ale naozaj len možno by sa nad ňou mohol zmilovať. Žena, s ktorou prežil dvadsaťdva rokov, ktorá pri ňom stála v dobrom aj v zlom a ktorá mu porodila jeho synov.
en: The Ice King looked down at his queen, disgust from his eyes. Maybe, just maybe, he would have mercy on her. The woman who he had been with for twenty-two years, the one who always cared for him at his lowest times, the one who had given birth to his sons.

sk: „V poriadku. Dieťa môže bývať v paláci“, začal, sledovaný pohľadom kráľovnej. „No teba dám popraviť“, dodal.
en: “Very well. The child may live in the palace.” He started, earning a sigh from the queen. “But,” he added. “You will be executed.”

sk: Na tvári radcu aj samotnej kráľovnej Eirwen sa zjavil výraz zdesenia. Jej zrak pomaly skĺzol na podlahu. „Ako si želáš, môj pane“, uklonila sa.
en: A shared look of horror came from the advisor and Queen Eirwen herself. She slowly looked down at the floor. “Yes, my king.” She bowed.

sk: Ľadový kráľ kráľovskému radcovi prikázal, aby kráľovninu dcéru odviedol do jednej z voľných kráľovských komnát. Potom pokynul strážam, aby priviedli Eirwen na popravisko, nech môže udalosť sledovať celé mesto.
en: The Ice King ordered the royal advisor to take the queen’s daughter to one of Eirwen’s vacant rooms. Once that was done he ordered the guards to bring Eirwen to the execution site, where all the townspeople could see.

sk: Keď v sprievode stráží prechádzala na popravisko, ľudia z mesta kričali pobúrením nad tým, že ich jedinú a najlepšiu kráľovnú idú zniesť zo sveta. Niektorí plakali, iní kričali a pokúšali sa napadnúť stráže, ďalší sa pýtali, čo sa vlastne deje; všetci však videli vec rovnako.
en: As the guards escorted her to the site, the townspeople cried out in outrage at seeing their only queen- and the nicest one- about to be killed. Some people were crying, some people were shouting and trying to attack the guards, and others were wondering why this was happening; but they all shared the same basis.

sk: „Nechajte ju na pokoji!“
en: “Let her go!”

sk: „Prečo jej ubližujete?“
en: “Why are they doing this to her?”

sk: Keď bola Eirwen pri drevenom kole, objavil sa najobávanejší človek v kráľovstve. Pán ohňa. Bývalú kráľovnú Eirwen idú upáliť. Takú smrť si nezaslúžil nik, ani zločinci. Bola to tá najukrutnejšia vec, akú ste mohli obyvateľovi Frostfellu vykonať.
en: As Eirwen approached the wooden pole, the most feared person in the kingdom showed up. The fire user. The former Queen Eirwen was going to be burned to death. Nobody deserved that death, not even the criminals. It was the most cruel thing you could do to a person in Frostfell.

sk: Eirwen priviazali k drevenému kolu a kráľ začal hovoriť o tom, ako ich kráľovná všetkých zradila. Obyvatelia Frostfellu tomu odmietali uveriť, jeho slová boli pre nich neprijateľné. Pán ohňa vzápätí kôl podpálil a po tvári bývalej kráľovnej stiekla osamotená slza.
en: Eirwen was tied up to the wooden pole and the king started speaking about how the queen betrayed all of them. The people of Frostfell refused to believe it and never accepted his words. Then, the fire user lit the pole on fire, and a single tear rolled down the former queen’s face.

sk: „Nech žije Kari.“ Takto skončila vláda kráľovnej Eirwen.
en: “Live on, Kari.” That was the end of the reign of Queen Eirwen.

sk: Mĺkve chodby
en: Silence in the Halls

sk: Ťuk, ťuk, ťuk... Jediný zvuk, ktorý vychádzal z najvzdialenejšej komnaty vľavo v južnom krídle večne studeného paláca. Slúžky prechádzajúce okolo odjakživa zaujímalo, čo sa v komnate skrýva, a zároveň z toho mali obavy. Dievčatá slúžiace v paláci šírili po chodbách rozličné klebety. Šuškalo sa, že v komnate prebýva mŕtva žena Ľadového kráľa a čaká, kedy ju niekto vyslobodí.
en: Tap, tap, tap was all you could hear from the farthest room on the left in the south wing of the eternally cold palace. The servants passing by always wondered what was in the room, scared of what was inside. Rumors danced around the halls by the maids. It was thought that the Ice King’s deceased wife, Eirwen, was in that room, waiting to be let out.

sk: Nemohli sa mýliť viac, myslel si Ivory prichádzajúci do južného krídla v sprievode úslužného šepotu stien. Nemajú potuchy, čo v tej komnate je.
en: They couldn’t be more wrong. Ivory thought, walking toward the south wing, as the help roamed the walls whispering to each other. They don’t know what’s in there at all.

sk: Chýry sa samozrejme týkali aj jeho ako jedinému človeku, ktorý smel do komnaty vstúpiť.
en: The rumors, of course, also applied to them as they were the only person allowed to enter the room.

sk: Klop klop. „Madam Kari, ste tam?“, zašepkal Ivory do precízne vyrobených dverí ozdobených snehovými vločkami a korunou, symbolom kráľovskej rodiny.
en: Knock knock. “Lady Kari, are you in there?” Ivory whispered to the intricate door, which was laid in snowflakes and a crown, the symbol of the royal family.

sk: Bol zvedavý, či ho už na rozdiel od predchádzajúcich návštev pustí dnu. Modrina z posledného pokusu sa mu stále nezahojila. Ivory sa pri tej spomienke uchechtol. Kari mu hodila do ramena knihu, ale keď zistila, o koho ide, hneď sa ospravedlnila.
en: They wondered if she would actually let them enter, unlike the previous times they went to ask. I still have a bruise from the last time. Ivory chuckled from the memory. Kari had thrown a book at their shoulder, but when she saw who it was, she apologized immediately.

sk: Z druhej strany dverí sa ozvalo jediné ťuknutie, čo by mohlo znamenať, že je tam. Veď aj tak nemala ako odísť.
en: A single tap came from inside, seeming to say that she was there, after all, there was nowhere to go.

sk: „Smiem vstúpiť?“, spýtal sa Ivory a spomenul si na časy, keď mohol vstúpiť bez opýtania.
en: “May I come in?” Ivory asked, remembering the time they went in without asking.

sk: Jediné ťuknutie z opačnej strany. To je podľa všetkého áno. Ivoryho striaslo zimou aj oným zvukom. Zdalo sa mu čudné, že z izby, ktorá mala byť prázdna, vychádza zvuk. A to tam pritom chodil už roky.
en: One tap came from inside. Yes, it seemed to say. Ivory shivered, from the cold and the sound. It felt kind of weird to Ivory hearing a noise coming from a presumably vacant room, even though they have been going into there for years.

sk: „Idem dnu“, povedal Ivory a pomaly otvoril dvere. Naskytol sa mu podľa bežných ľudských štandardov nezvyčajný, no nie nečakaný pohľad. Všade ležali listy papiera. Po miestnosti boli rozhádzané knihy, stôl bol zlomený a všade sa povaľovali ľadové sošky. Komnata nemala okná a vládla v nej tma. Okrem toho tu bolo chladnejšie ako v ostatných častiach paláca (čo samo osebe hovorilo za všetko). Komnata vyzerala, ako keby sa v nej vyzúrila snehová búrka.
en: “I’m coming in.” Ivory said, slowly opening the door. The sight they saw in the room was unusual , by normal people’s standards , but not unexpected. Papers were everywhere. Books were scattered about, the desk was broken, and there were multiple ice sculptures scattered about. There were no windows and little to no light. It was also colder than the rest of the palace (which was saying a lot). The room looked like a snowstorm blew it all out of place.

sk: Dievča ležalo v posteli stočené do klbka a zabalené v deke čítalo jeden zo svojich zápisníkov. Celý priestor osvetľovala jedna malá lucerna.
en: The girl in the room was curled up onto her bed, currently wrapped in her comforter as she read one of her notebooks. A small lantern lighting up the space.

sk: „Ktorý je to zápisník?“, spýtal sa Ivory, keď si prisadol ku Kari na posteľ.
en: “Which notebook is that?” Ivory asked, sitting down next to Kari on her bed.

sk: Prelistovala na prázdnu stranu a napísala na ňu dátum. Pod dátum napísala: „5/11/648 - 12/13/648.“
en: She flipped to a blank page and wrote the date on it. Under it, she wrote, “5/11/648 -12/13/648.”

sk: „Prezeráš si zašlé spomienky?“, spýtal sa Ivory pri pohľade na starý zápisník. Kari prikývla. „Myslíš, že ťa na Vianoce pustia von? Je to o pár dní.“
en: “Reviewing old memories?” Ivory inquired, looking at the old notebook. Kari nodded. “Do you think that they will let you out for Christmas? It’s only a few days away.”

sk: Kari dvakrát poklepala na lucernu. Nie, presne, ako si Ivory myslel. Ľadový kráľ ju nikdy nepúšťal von, pokladal ju za „tŕň“ v oku. Narodila sa nemá a bola jediným dievčaťom v inak čisto mužskej rodine.
en: Kari tapped twice on the lantern. No, as Ivory predicted. The Ice King never let Kari out, as she was seen as “a flaw” in his eyes. She was born mute and was the only girl in her family, as it was all made up of boys.

sk: Aj Ivory bol svojím spôsobom tŕňom v oku. Keď sa priznal k svojej nebinárnej identite, tiež sa zdalo, že celý svet je zrazu iný. Ako trest za svoju odlišnosť dostával práce, pri ktorých trávil väčšinu času osamote.
en: Ivory was too, in their own special way. When Ivory came out as nonbinary, it seemed like the world changed too. They were given the jobs that would make them spend time alone for most of the time, as a punishment for being different.

sk: Okrem toho musel robiť princeznej sluhu, čo mu však až tak neprekážalo, pretože sa postupne skamarátili.
en: They were also forced to work as the princess’ servant. They didn’t mind it much thought, as they got a friend too.

sk: „Onedlho budeš mať narodeniny, všakže?“, spýtal sa Ivory, keď si spomenul, že princezná má o niekoľko dní sviatok. Kari prikývla a v bledomodrých očiach sa jej zjavil smútok.
en: “It’s your birthday soon, isn’t it?” Ivory asked, remembering that the princess’ birthday was in a few days. Kari nodded, a sad glint in her light blue eyes.

sk: „Chcela by si oslavu?“, opýtal sa Ivory a hlavou mu preletela spomienka na moment, keď jej túto otázku položil naposledy.
en: “Do you want to celebrate?” They asked, reflecting on the last time she answered it.

sk: Nie, vyklepkala Kari. Ivory vedel, že narodeniny sú pre ňu bolestivá téma. V deň jej narodenia ju totiž uväznili v tejto komnate a jej matku poslali do vyhnanstva. Ivory bol vtedy malé dieťa, ale pamätal si, ako to sluhov a obyvateľov mesta rozhnevalo. Počul, že kráľovná Eirwen bola veľmi dobrá, ale že vedela akýmsi zvláštnym spôsob predpovedať budúcnosť.
en: No. Kari tapped out. Ivory knew that it was a hard subject for her. It was the day that she was confined to her room and her mother was banished. Ivory was only a baby when it happened, but they remembered the outrage the servants and townspeople were in. They heard Queen Eirwen was a nice queen, but also weirdly predicted things that would happen.

sk: „Takže... čo by si chcela robiť?“, spýtal sa. Kari naňho vzhliadla pohľadom plným vzrušenia. Podala mu kus papiera. Keď sa naň však Ivory pozrel...
en: “So… whatcha wanna do?” They asked. Kari looked up at them, teeming with excitement. She handed Ivory a paper. When they looked down at it however…

sk: Plátno s rozmermi 15 x 15 cm
en: 6in x 6in painting canvas

sk: Bielu a rozličné odtiene modrej farby
en: White, varying shades of blue paint

sk: 6 rozličných veľkostí štetcov
en: 6 different sizes of paint brushes

sk: Maliarsky stojan
en: Easel

sk: „Chceš, aby som ti tieto veci zohnal?“, otočil sa Ivory k nemej princeznej, ktorá vyklepávala písmená, až sa jej vrkôčiky natriasali. „Áno?“ Ivory sa nenápadne uškrnul, keď videl, ako sa za normálnych okolností utiahnutá princezná dokáže pre niečo nadchnúť. Prvý raz požiadala o inú vec, ako boli knihy v jej komnate.
en: “You want me to get these things for you?” Ivory turned toward the silent princess, who was tapping a lot, pig tails swishing back and forth. “Yes?” They giggled slightly as they saw the normally withdrawn princess was passionate about something. It was the first time she had ever asked for something not related to books that was outside her room.

sk: „OK! Uvidíme sa neskôr?“, spýtal sa Ivory, keď vstal a snažil sa prekľučkovať cez záplavu papiera a zápisníkov.
en: “Okay! See ya later?” Ivory asked, standing up and weaving through the mess of papers and notebooks.

sk: Kari prikývla, pevnejšie sa zavinula do hrubej deky a vrátila sa k prezeraniu svojich záznamov.
en: Kari nodded, going back to reviewing her memories and curling up in her thick comforter.

sk: Ivory vyšiel z komnaty s pocitom úľavy, že princezná konečne vyšla zo svojej komfortnej zóny a požiadala o niečo z vonkajšieho sveta, čo si nevedela zadovážiť sama, ako sú napríklad farbičky.
en: They exited the room, relieved that the princess was finally pushing out of her comfort zone and asking for things outside of her power, like paint.

sk: Opäť sa vydal na cestu chodbami a snažil sa ignorovať neodbytný šepot chyžných.
en: They walked through the halls again, trying to tune out the whispers of the maids again.

sk: „Počula som, že kráľovná Eirwen si ju úplne omotala okolo prsta, preto za ňou stále chodí.“
en: “ I heard that she’s getting possessed by Queen Eirwen, that’s why she’s always going to that room.”

sk: „Ja som počula, že v tej komnate žerie malé deti.“
en: “I heard that she eats children in that room.”

sk: „Vyzerá ako muž, čudné, že?“
en: “ She looks like a man, isn’t that wrong?”

sk: Reči sa Ivorymu vkrádali do uší, či chcel alebo nechcel, preto si ich zakryl dlaňami a vybral sa do komnaty kráľovského maliara, ktorá bola vo východnom krídle, druhé dvere vľavo.
en: They covered their ears, as tuning them out wasn’t working. They made their way to the royal painter’s room, which was on the east wing, second door on the left.

sk: Ivory pristúpil k dverám, ktoré boli rovnako precízne vypracované ako dvere na Kariinej komnate. Bol na nich vyobrazený Biely drak, jeden zo šiestich pravekých drakov, ktoré údajne vybudovali Frostfell. Bolo celkom logické, že tento výjav sa nachádza práve na dverách maliara, mal totiž rád históriu.
en: Ivory approached the door that was just as intricate as Kari’s. On it was the White Dragon, one of the 6 primordial dragons, who allegedly created Frostfell. It would make sense for the painter to have it on his door though, he liked history.

sk: Ivory otvoril dvere a čakal, že uvidí bežný obraz - všade škvrny od farby, ceruzy a papiere rozhádzané po miestnosti, maliarske stojany pokrývajúce každý centimeter štvorcový steny. Skutočnosť však bola úplne iná. Všetko bolo ako zo škatuľky a na pozadí z červeného zamatu stál honosný stolec, na ktorom sedel korunný princ Aquilo a čakal, kým maliar dokončí jeho portrét.
en: They opened the door, expecting the normal sight. Paint splotches everywhere, pencils and papers scattered across the room, easels covering up every last inch of wall. Unexpectedly, there was a different sight to be found. It was all clean, and there was a red velvet background and a stool in front of it. On the stool was Crown Prince Aquilo, getting his portrait done.

sk: „Ach, Ivory, vitaj! Chceš sa pozrerať na dokončenie portrétu tvojho budúceho kráľa?“, žmurkol na Ivoryho Aquilo.
en: “Ah, good morning, Ivory! Care to watch your future king get his portrait done?” Aquilo inquired, winking at Ivory.

sk: „Soráč, princík“, povedal Ivory na pol úst a pustil sa do hľadania vecí, o ktoré ho poprosila jeho nemá priateľka. „Prišiel som zobrať nejaké pomôcky na maľovanie.“
en: “Sorry, princey,” They said, partially ignoring him and searching for the things that their silent friend wanted. “I’m just here to get art supplies.”

sk: „Ups, dievčatko je už na odchode?“, spýtal sa Aquilo. „Počkaj, niečo som od teba potreboval!“
en: “Aw baby girl’s gonna leave so soon?” Aquilo asked, “But I wanted to see you!”

sk: „Nabudúce.“ Ivory našiel všetky pomôcky na zozname a vložil ich do prázdnej nepoužívanej debny. „A nie som dievča.“
en: “Well I didn’t.” Ivory found the art supplies on their list and put it in a crate that they found. “And I’m not a girl.”

sk: Princ však poznámku prepočul. „Zlatko, vieš, že je to len isté obdobie života! O chvíľu z toho vyrastieš!“, dokončil šušľavo.
en: The prince didn’t think this though. “Aw baby, you know it’s just a phase! You’re going to grow out of it when you’re older!” He said, slurring his words.

sk: „Musím ísť“, povedal Ivory, ktorého princova odpoveď znenazdajky dostala do úzkych. Spomenul si na všetky zlé veci, ktoré ľudia o jeho rodovej identite povraveli. Naozaj nemal dôvod zostávať pri ňom dlhšie.
en: “I have to go.” They said, suddenly feeling uncomfortable when the prince said back. Remembering all the bad things people said about their gender identity. I really want to get away from him.

sk: „Kam tak skoro?“, princ sa v sekunde zhmotnil pri dverách nedbajúc na prosby kráľovského maliara.
en: “Leaving so soon?” The prince instantaneously appeared at the door, ignoring the cries of one royal painter.

sk: „Takto by sa budúci kráľ rozhodne správať nemal!“, ohradil sa Ivory.
en: “This isn’t the way a future king should act!” They demanded.

sk: „Nikto sa o tom nedozvie. Tebe ľudia neuveria a maliar bude držať jazyk za zubami, ak mu je život milý.“ Krátko sa obzrel na maliara, potom sa naklonil bližšie k Ivorymu. „Čo by si povedal na malé rande?“ Ivoryho sa zmocnila triaška. Už sa mu párkrát stalo, že sa mu niekto vyhrážal, nikdy to však nebol princ, a už vôbec nie budúci kráľ.
en: “Nobody’s gonna know. The people won’t believe you and the painter won’t say anything if he values his life.” He looked back at the painter for a second, then leaned closer to Ivory. “Whatddya say about going on a date?” They shivered. Sure, they had heard multiple threats in the past, but it had never come from a prince, let alone the one next in line to be king.

sk: „Vieš vôbec, čo znamená slovo 'nie'?“, vyštekol Ivory a snažil sa princa od seba odtlačiť.
en: “Do you even know what the word ‘no’ means?” They spat out, pushing the crown prince away from them.

sk: „Nie“, odpovedal Aquilo s úsmevom. Samozrejme, že princ, ktorý dostal vždy všetko, čo chcel, nemohol význam toho slova poznať.
en: “Nope.” Aquilo answered back, smiling. Of course the crown prince who gets everything he wants doesn’t know what the word even means.

sk: Ivory prevrátil oči. „Prečo by si chcel ísť na rande zo všetkých ľudí práve so mnou? Tvoje obdivovateľky sa predsa rátajú na stovky, či?“
en: Ivory rolled their eyes. “Why do you even want to go on a date with me of all people? You have like, I don’t know, 100 suitors?”

sk: „Skôr na tisícky“, skočil princ Ivorymu do reči. Pohodil vlasmi dozadu, až to v studenom vzduchu zasvišťalo.
en: He cut in, still smiling, “500 actually.” He threw his hair back, swishing it in the cold air.

sk: „No vidíš! Tak prečo práve ja? Som postrachom paláca“, Ivory si ovinul ramená okolo tela.
en: “See! Why me of all people? I’m the palace menace.” They hugged their arms.

sk: „Si najkrajšie dievča, aké som kedy videl.“ Aquilo priložil Ivorymu prst pod bradu a prinútil ho, aby sa naňho pozrel.
en: “You’re the prettiest girl I’ve ever seen.” Aquilo puts one digit under their chin and forces Ivory to look up at him.

sk: Kapitola 1
en: Chapter 1

sk: Cohren
en: Cohren

sk: 4:30 itaniaského času. Cohren toto skoré vstávanie nenávidel, a to najmä preto, že musel zobudiť všetkých ostatných členov posádky. Nečujne vstal z prične, obliekol si uniformu, prehodil si cez ňu taktickú vestu a zbalil si veci zo skrinky. Osobitnú pozornosť pritom venoval malému boxu. Cez plece si prevesil pušku a na háčik pripojený k opasku pripevnil helmu. Výstroj obsahovala všetko potrebné od respirátora až po okuliare. Skontroloval si puzdrá s nábojmi a ticho vyšiel z baraku, šliapuc bagančami po blate a ľade.
en: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.

sk: Z jedného vrecka bundy vytiahol zapaľovač, z druhého cigaretu. Zapálil si, dal si rýchly šluk a pootvoril dvere. Za posledný týždeň vyskúšal pri budení mužov a žien pod svojím velením rôzne taktiky. Prestal používať nastavený budík; v polovici prípadov bol úplne neúčinný, pretože z reproduktorov sa ozvalo iba jemné sipenie.
en: He took a lighter from his jacket pocket and a cig from the other. Lighting it, he took a small drag before opening the door slightly. Over the last week he had to get creative when waking the men and women under his command. He stopped using the preset wake up alarm, half the time it never worked, when all that came from the speakers was a light hiss.

sk: „Ideš budiť?“ Cohren sa otočil a uvidel prichádzať podporučíka Nemica.
en: “Waking them up” Cohren turned to see 2nd Lieutenant Nemic walking up.

sk: „Tak tak“, odpovedal Cohren.
en: “Yup” Cohren responded.

sk: „Čo si vymyslel tentokrát?“
en: “What did you plan on using this time?”

sk: Ešte než stihol odpovedať, dvere sa otvorili dokorán a von sa vyhrnuli oblečení a vyzbrojení Harris, Craith a niekoľko ďalších vojakov.
en: Before he could answer, the door opened and Harris, Craith, and a few others hurried out, already fully dressed and kitted out.

sk: „Ránečko“, povedal Craith.
en: “Morning,” Craith said.

sk: „Čo vás vyhnalo z postelí, hoši?“, spýtal sa Cohren.
en: “What woke you guys up?” Cohren asked.

sk: „Ehm, po prvé, akosi sme nemali záujem zistiť, čo si si na budenie zase prichystal. Po druhé, ktorá úderná jednotka prvá vstane, tá si prvá berie žrádlo“, odpovedal jeden z mužov menom Ravik. „A dobre vieš, že zohnať jedlo nie je sranda.“
en: “Well, One, we didn’t want to see what you had in mind for waking the company up today. Second, the first Shock Troops to get up get first pick of the morning chow” One of the men, Ravik, answered. “And you know for a fact how bad they can get”

sk: „Dobrý postreh, Profík“, povedal Cohren. Načiahol sa dnu a šťukol vypínačom. V barakoch sa rozoznel hlasný jačavý alarm. Zvnútra začul tlmený krik a kroky ľudí.
en: “You make a good point Specialist,” Cohren said. He reached in and flicked a switch. An alarm sounded inside of the barracks, loud and screeching. He heard muffled shouting inside and people stumbling about.

sk: „Kámo, Valturi“, hlesol Nemic. „Dalo bz sa očakávať, že sa už naučili vstávať vtedy, keď ty.“
en: “Jeez Valturi,” Nemic stated. “You’d think they would have learned by now to wake up when you did”

sk: „Tuto moji kamoši z cvičáku to už majú za sebou“, ukázal Cohren na Harrisa, Craitha a Ravika. „Ich čatári a rotní velitelia však stále vedia, ako vstať skôr než vojaci.“
en: “Well my buddys from boot camp here did” Cohren motioned to Harris, Craith and Ravik. “But then again, their squad and platoon leader’s, they know to wake up before their units.

sk: O pár sekúnd neskôr sa von začali trúsiť ostatní členovia posádky. Mali so sebou všetko potrebné od osobných vecí až po nevyhnutnú výbavu. Na niektorých nováčikoch bolo vidieť, že sú dezorientovaní, iní zas vyzerali dosť namrzene.
en: Seconds later the rest of the company came streaming out. They all had everything they needed, from personal items to needed gear. A few of the newer recruits look disoriented, others more annoyed.

sk: „Bré ráno všetkým“, predniesol Cohren bodrým hlasom.
en: “Morning everyone” Cohren said in a cheery voice.

sk: „Bez urážky, pane, ale prečo nás musíte budiť týmto spôsobom?“, spýtal sa jeden z desiatnikov údernej jednotky.
en: “With all respect sir, why do you have to wake us up like that?” One of the Shock Troopers, a corporal, asked.

sk: „Pretože bežný alarm je na hovno. A okrem toho Úsvit si tiež nedáva načas“, vyhlásil Cohren.
en: “Cause the regular alarms are shit. And because Daybreak doesn't sleep in” Cohren stated.

sk: „Skontrolujte si, či máte všetky osobné veci“, pokračoval. Ako nadporučík a riaditeľ spoločnosti bol zodpovedný za to, že skontroluje posádku a že poskytne šéfovi spoločnosti kapitánovi Boradinovi Shawovi pomoc. „Nikto sa nebude vracať. Čatári a podporučíci, dávam vám a vašim čatám pätnásť minút, aby ste si všetko ešte raz skontrolovali a aby ste si vzali denný prídel.“
en: “Make sure you have all your personal belongings,” Cohren continued. As a 1st Lieutenant and Company XO, it was his responsibility to oversee and assist the company with the Company leader, Captain Boradin Shaw . “We won’t be returning. Sergeants and 2nd lieutenants, I'm giving you and your squads fifteen minutes to make final checks and grab rations for the day”

sk: Členovia spoločnosti Exodus sa rýchlo rozpŕchli. Boli súčasťou 2. divízie údernej jednotky 2. armádneho zboru. Pred zlúčením išlo o dve samostatné spoločnosti Cohort a Dagger. Spoločnosti hrozil rozpad a Cohren mal zmiešané pocity z toho, že ho povýšili na nadporučíka. Nepáčili sa mu najmä dôvody.
en: The members of Exodus company quickly dispersed. They were a part of the 2nd Shocktrooper Division, 2nd Army. They were originally two separate companies, Cohort and Dagger, before being consolidated. They were a cracked company, and Cohren felt mixed feelings about being promoted to 1st Lieutenant, mainly due to the reasons.

sk: Cohren a veliteľ 1. roty Nemic kráčali vedľa seba osvetlení mnohými lampami predsunutej základne napájanými z generátorov. Väčšina z nich mala červený odtieň, aby boli lepšie ukrytí pred nepriateľskými bombardérmi. Úsvit sa v rámci boja uchýlil k útokom pomocou Wild Weasel, a to tak zo vzduchu, ako aj po zemi.
en: Cohren and Nemic, the leader of 1st Platoon, walked together under the light of the FOB's many lights, powered by generators. Most were tinted red to help keep them hidden from enemy bombers. Daybreak had resorted to Wild Weasel attacks, both in the air and on the ground, to combat them.

sk: „Ďalší deň, ďalšia úloha pre bojovníkov v prvej línii“, zasmial sa Nemic sucho. „Kam nás posielajú?“
en: “Another day, another task for Hell’s Frontrunners” Nemic started with a dry laugh. “Where are they sending us?”

sk: „Na predsunutú základňu mimo Ianlosu. Máme poskytnúť podporu pri pozemnom útoku“, odpovedal Cohren a potiahol si z cigarety. Polovica mozgu mu hovorila, aby sa na Craitha hneval, že ho naučil fajčiť, rok bojov ho však výrazne zmenil, nepovedal teda nič.
en: “A FOB outside Ianlos. We are being sent to help support the ground assault” Cohren answered, taking a drag from his cigarette. Half of him blamed Craith for getting him into smoking, but a year of combat does a lot to you, so he didn’t say anything.

sk: „Do riti. Na fronte sa to zhoršuje“, zamrmlal Nemic. „Všetky odchádzajúce správy hovoria: Podporte vojnové úsilie; Pošlite pomoc na Kurganov front; Viete poslať pomoc na Howlandov front?“.
en: “Shit. Its getting bad on the front, '' Nemic muttered. “All the news leaving this place is ‘Support the war effort. Send aid to the Kurgan Front’ how about sending aid to the Howland Front”

sk: „Amen, braček“, povedal Cohren odhadzujúc ohorok do blata. „V každom prípade vyrážame s 1. ozbrojenou rotou, aby sme nemuseli ísť peši. Kapitán Shaw by mal mať na starosti...“
en: “Amen brother” Cohren said as he flicked the remains of the cigarette into the mud. “Anyway, we're heading out with the 1st armored platoon, so we don’t have to walk. Captain Shaw should be their”

sk: „Povezieme sa so Shawom?“, spýtal sa mierne prekvapený Nemic.
en: “Shaw got us a ride?” Nemic asked, a little surprised.

sk: „Presne tak. Ak mám povedať pravdu, nie je taký zlý, ako som si myslel. Teda, nie je to žiadna výhra, ale dá sa to s ním vydržať.“
en: “Yup. Honestly, he isn’t as bad as I thought he was. I mean, he’s not great, but he isn’t unbearable”

sk: Cohren zdvihol palec a ukazovák k mikrofónu na golieri a zároveň si posunul ruksak na chrbte. „Všetkým jednotkám spoločnosti Exodus, keď budete hotoví, stretneme sa pri Západnej umývačke. Vyrážame s 1. ozbrojenou rotou o 5:00.“
en: Cohren lifted his thumb and index finger to his throat mic, shifting his pack on his back while he did. “All units in Exodus Company, meet at Motor Pool West when you're finished. We are heading out with the 1st Armored Platoon at 0500”

sk: Report od čatárov dostával každých pár sekúnd. Keď sa sem Haris, Craith a Ravik dostali, nemali žiadnu dôstojnícku hodnosť. Všetci štyria boli dobrí priatelia už od základného výcviku na Zemi. Odkedy sa spoznali, neprešli ani dva roky, ale Cohrenovi to pripadalo ako večnosť. Pred týždňom sa Craigh stal veliteľom 2. roty, jeho predchodcu totiž prepustili zo zdravotných dôvodov, keď schytal guľku od snipera z Úsvitu.
en: Every few seconds he got a response from the squad leaders. Haris, Craith, and Ravik had all been low ranking NCO when they all got there. All four of them had been good friends since basic back on Earth. It felt so long ago now since Cohren had met them, even though it couldn’t have been two years ago. They were squad leaders, But Craith was now leading 2nd Platoon as of a week ago, after the previous leader had gotten medically discharged after catching a bullet from a Daybreak sniper.

sk: Na ceste k umývačke si Cohren a Nemic všimli skupinu približne ôsmich hlavných bojových tankov Kronos a štyri Strykery. Posádka krúžila okolo nich a pripravovala bojové stroje na cestu. Cohrenov pohľad čoskoro našiel kapitána Boradina Shawa, ktorý sa práve rozprával s veliteľom obrnenej roty. Keď vystúpili na plošinu, Shaw sa pozrel hore a prišiel za nimi. Na jeho zvyčajne chladnej tvári nebola ani stopa po emóciách.
en: Walking up to the motor pool, Cohren and Nemic’s eye fell on a group of around eight Kronos Main Battle Tanks and four Strykers. Their crew milled about, making sure their war machines were ready to go. Cohren’s gaze soon found Captain Boradin Shaw, who was talking with the armored platoon’s commander. As they walked up, Shaw looked over and walked up, his usually cold face masking all emotions.

sk: „Poručík Nemic... Poručík Valturi...“, predbehol Cohrena, ktorý sa pohľadom pristavil na puzdre svojej pištole, až potom pozrel na Shawa. „Predpokladám, že posádka je pripravená.“
en: “Lieutenant Nemic…Lieutenant Valturi…” He said Cohren was slower, glancing at Cohren’s pistol holster before glancing up again. “I assume that the company is ready”

sk: „Je, pane. Už by mala byť na ceste, dali sme im čas, aby si z toho bordelu vybrali prídely jedla.“  Presne o 5:00 sa vojaci spoločnosti Exodus stretli pri umývačke. Shaw sa postavil na box a začal rozprávať.
en: “Yes sir. There should be on their way now, we gave them time to grab rations from the mess” 	At 0500 sharp, Exodus company assembled at the motor pool. Shaw stepped onto a box and began to speak.

sk: „Presúvame sa do FOB I-131, 80 kilometrov od Ianlosu. Našou úlohou je pomôcť pri tamojšom obliehaní a potom v Ianlose zaútočiť a potlačiť údajné povstanie. Oporný bod a základňu budeme mať na úpätí hôr“, vysvetľoval Shaw. „Zoraďte sa podľa čiat a poďte hore.“
en: “Where are moving out to FOB I-131, fifty miles outside of Ianlos. We are to support the ongoing siege and later attack of Ianlos to flush out the insurgency there. From there we will have a foothold and the base of the mountains” Shaw explained. “Get with your squads and mount up”

sk: Vojaci sa rozbehli, aby sa mohli zaradiť každý do svojej čaty. Čatári ich postupne navádzali na tanky. Cohren sa vyšplhal na jeden z tankov na konci konvoja, kde sa pridal k Nemicovi, Craithovi a dvom novým regrútom. Pamätal si, že prišli pred pár dňami, nevedel však o nich takmer nič. Sadol si na bok a s nohami voľne visiacimi na jednej strane si napravil batoh a rádioprijímač s prepojením na slúchadlo a na mikrofón, ktorý mal na golieri.
en: The company dispersed, joining together in their squads and their sergeants had them mount up on one of the tanks. Cohren pulled himself onto one of the tanks farther up on the convoy, joining Nemic, Craith, and two new recruits. Cohren remembered them arriving a few days ago, but didn’t know much about them. Sitting on the side, dangling his legs on the side, he adjusted his pack and radio set, which connected to his earpiece and throat mic.

sk: „Počuj, Cohren, Harris má stále toho svojho Snehuliaka?“, spýtal sa Nemic, keď sa usadili.
en: “Hey Cohren, does Harris still have Snowball?” Nemic asks as they got settled in.

sk: „Myslíš tú pipku, ktorú ukradol?“ Cohren si spomenul na to ráno, keď Snehuliaka ukradli z farmy. „Určite áno.“
en: “You mean his chicken he stole?” Cohren remembered the morning they had stolen him from a farm. “Yeah, i'm pretty sure”

sk: Cohren sa pozrel na vedľajší tank a zbadal Harrisa so svojou čatou. V zadnej časti jeho batohu zaregistroval pohyb kuriatka, ktoré otáčalo hlavou a sledovalo okolie.
en: Cohren glanced over to one of the other tanks and spotted Harris with his squad. From the back of his pack he could just make out the movement of a small chicken moving its head around, scanning the surroundings.

sk: „Hej, ešte ho má“, odpovedal Cohren, keď sa poklop na veži tanku so zarinčaním otvoril a objavil sa veliteľ.
en: “Yup, he still has him” Cohren answered as the tank's turret hatch clanked open and its commander came into view.

sk: „Všetky tanky sú na ceste“, začal veliteľ pokojným, ale jasným tónom hovoriť do slúchadiel. Motory tankovej roty a Strykerov s revom naskočili a vozidlá sa pohli vpred. Kronos, na ktorom bol Cohren, s uvoľnením bŕzd poskočil a vyrazil smerom k formácii. Tanky prechádzali rovinami Itánie v tvare klinu. Zimné búrky pokryli mokrade a lesy ľadom, bahna sa však nikdy úplne nezbavili.
en: “All tanks were moving out” The commander started calmly but clearly into his headset. The engines of a platoon of tanks and Strykers roared to life as they started moving forward. The Kronos Cohren was on jolted as its break released and moved forward, getting into formation. The tanks took up a wedge formation as they moved across the Itania plains. The winter storms had frozen over the wetlands and forests, but the mud always remained.

sk: Približne po hodine sa ozval jeden z nováčikov, Orson, ak si Cohren dobre pamätal. „Poručík, vy ste tu od začiatku vojny, všakže?“
en: After around an hour, one of the new recruits, Cohren, remembered his name being Orson, spoke up. “Lieutenant, you’ve been here since the start of the war, right?”

sk: „Presne tak, operácia Ohnivá búrka“, odpovedal Cohren. „Mysleli sme si, že o pár týždňov bude po všetkom, lenže... podcenili sme ich.“
en: “Yup, Operation Firestorm,” Cohren answered. “We thought it would be over in a few weeks, but…we underestimate them”

sk: „Podcenili je slabé slovo“, pridal sa k nim Nemic. „Majú viac zbraní a vojakov, než sme čakali. V prvých dvoch týždňoch sa im podarilo zostreliť UFS Revenant a minulý mesiac aj Erebus. Krista, z trasy, po ktorej sme išli, sme to mohli vidieť.“
en: “Underestimated is putting it lightly” Nemic joined in the conversation. “They had more weapons and manpower than we were prepared for. They were able to shoot down The UFS Revenant in the first two weeks, and just last month the Erebus. Hell, we should see it from the route were taking”

sk: „Ja hájim v každom prípade záujmy Federácie“, povedal Orson s hrdosťou. „Nejakí teroristi mi určite nenaženú strach.“
en: “Well, I’ll stand defiantly for the Federation” Orson said defiantly. “I’ll not let those terrorist scare me”

sk: „To hovoríš teraz, ale z vlastných skúseností viem, že väčšina 18-ročných nováčikov zalezie pri prvom výstrele do kabíny“, vyhlásil Craith.
en: “You say that now, but from what I have seen, most fresh eighteen year old recruits like yourself dive to cover as soon as you hear a gunshot” Craith stated.

sk: „Však to o chvíľu zistíme“, povedal Cohren so smiechom. Orson zmĺkol.
en: “I guess we’ll find out,” Cohren said with a laugh. Orson didn’t continue the conversation.

sk: „Exodus XO, Exodus CO“, v Cohrenovej vysielačke zapraskalo. „300 metrov pred nami, 20 stupňov vpravo sme zachytili tepelnú stopu.“
en: “Exodus XO, Exodus CO” Cohrens radio crackled. “We're picking up heat signatures 350 yards out, 20 degrees right”

sk: Cohren sa vytiahol na plošinu tanku a nasadil si optické okuliare. Prepol ich do termo režimu a v diaľke zbadal tepelné škvrny.
en: Cohren pulled himself up to the top of the tank and pushed his Optic Goggles. Switching them to Thermal, he could see heat signatures in the distance.

sk: „Hej, mám ich“, odpovedal Cohren do mikrofónu na golieri.
en: “Yup, I see them” Cohren responded, using his throat mic.

sk: „Nepriateľ?“, spýtala sa druhá záklaďáčka Natayla.
en: “Enemy’s?” The other recruit, Natayla, asked.

sk: „To ešte nevieme“, zahlásil Cohren. Nahol sa k mikrofónu a spustil. „Spoločnosť Exodus, strieľame, až keď začnú strieľať oni, necháme ich vyjsť von.“
en: “Can’t tell,” Cohren stated. He reached for his mic and spoke. “Exodus Company, hold fire unless fired upon, let's draw them out

sk: Keď prišli bližšie, drobné tepelné stopy sa zmenili zo škvŕn na zreteľnejšie obrysy. Z ešte menšej vzdialenosti videli jeden z obrysov, ako po niečo beží, berie to a kľučkuje späť na malý horský hrebeň, na ktorom sa zdržiavali. Postavy si políhali do palebných pozícií.
en: As they drew closer, the little heat signatures turned from blobs to more distinct shapes. As they drew closer, one of them ran for something and grabbed it before rusing back to the small ridge they were on. The figures dropped down into firing positions.

sk: „Máme kontakt“, zrúkol Shaw do vysielačky, keď začali oranžové značky z hrebeňa strieľať. Strely sa odrazili od bočného plášťa tankov, za ktoré sa poschovávali vyliezajúci členovia údernej jednotky. Okolo zasvišťala protiraketová strela a s otrasom sa zaryla do zeme za chrbtom formácie, kde vybuchla a zasypala jeden z tankov úlomkami. Ďalšia strela typu APS-Cerberus dopadla a vybuchla vedľa Strykera, ktorého posádka po vypálení munície vyliezla von a vrhla sa do krytu.
en: “We got contacts” Shaw shouted through the radio as orange tracers fired from the ridge. Bullets pinged off the tanks side as Shock Troopers leaped off the tanks, taking cover behind them. An anti missile rocked, streaked by and slammed into the ground behind the formation, exploding and throwing debris onto one of the tanks. Another slammed into the side of a Stryker, a APS-Cerberus, and exploded. Its crew scrambled out and dove for cover as the ammo cooked off.

sk: „Iron 1-2 a 1-3, 25 stupňov vpravo, 250 metrov. Spustite paľbu“, kričal do vysielačky veliteľ tankovej roty. Iron 1-2 a 1-3 spustili paľbu. Ich strely vyleteli smerom k hrebeňu, kde vybuchli a do vzduchu sa vznieslo bahno a kamene.
en: “Iron 1-2 and 1-3, 25 degrees right, 300 yards. Open fire” The tank platoon commander shouted over the radio. Iron 1-2 and 1-3 opened fire, their shells streaking towards the ridge and exploded, sending mud and rock into the air.

sk: „Nasaďte Sentov“, zhúkol Knoxx pozorujúc hrebeň ďalekohľadom. Zadok jedného z Cerberusov sa otvoril a vystúpil neozbrojený vojak so špeciálnou výbavou na hlave. Do štvorcového mikrofónu zakričal pár príkazov a z vozidla sa vyhrnuli dvaja Senti, oficiálne nazývaní Sentinelovia. Keď sa pustili do šprintu, ich kostnaté kovové paže a nohy sa začali mihať vpred a vzad. Boli ozbrojení, ale zbrane mali prehodené cez plecia.
en: “Send in the Senti’s” Knoxx, who was watching the ridge through binocs, shouted. The back to one of the Cerberus’s opened and an unarmed soldier stepped out, wearing a special headset. He shouted orders into a square microphone and two Senti’s, formally known as Sentinels, rushed out. Their skinny metallic arms and legs swung forward as they broke into a sprint. They were armed, but their weapons were slung to their back.

sk: „Živých alebo mŕtvych?“, spýtal sa Craith ostatných, ktorí sa celému výjavu prizerali.
en: “Kill or capture?” Craith asked as they watched.

sk: „Zrejme živých“, usúdil Cohren, keď dvaja Sentinelovia zmizli v oblaku popola a dymu. Z hrebeňa sa ozval krik a výstrely, ktoré však rýchlo stíchli. O chvíľu už sentinelovia pochodovali späť a vliekli za sebou postavu, ktorá bagančami ryla zem. Keď sa dostali do bezpečia na území roty, hodili postavu na zem. Pri tvrdom dopade do blata a snehu zavrčala bolesťou.
en: “Looks like capture” Cohren guessed as the two Sentinels disappeared into the cloud of ash and smoke. Shouting and gunshots echoed from the ridge, but quickly ceased. A moment later the two sentinels marched back, pulling someone behind them, their boots dragging behind them. When they reached the safety of the platoon they threw the figure to the ground, he grunted in pain as they landed hard in the mud and snow.

sk: Shaw vykročil k dvíhajúcej sa postave, potom sa obrátil na jedného zo Sentinelov. „Koľko?“
en: Shaw walked up to the figure, who was starting to get up. He then turned to one of the Sentinels. “How many?”

sk: „Traja mŕtvi, pane“, odvetil Sentinel. „Ostatní utiekli.“
en: “Three dead, sir” The Sentinel answered. “The rest fled on foot”
